title: Bendigo pottery
creator_credit: Victoria. Ministry of Education, Trevor Lunn and Brendan Kenworthy
brief_description: This program gives some insight into the process involved in making pottery and shows some of the types of clay used, the preparation, pot throwing and glazing at the Bendigo pottery.
